header.subject: English
header.title: Memory Lane & Chat Time with Sir Riaz
header.goal: Children listen to a joke or fact, choose how they feel, and say why: “I feel ___ because ___.”

bring: textbook p.123 · chalk · children's books and pencils

moves.do: Ask: what do you remember about wild animals? Take three answers.
moves.how: Expect: “Wonders of the Wild.” Class echoes it.

moves.do: Open p.123. Point to Sir Riaz and his four speech bubbles.
moves.how: Say each key word with an action; children copy.
moves.say: “Today we listen to Sir Riaz's jokes and facts and say how we feel.”

moves.do: Model it once: read the tree joke, point to 😄, say why.
moves.how: Show good listening: face the speaker, repeat the reason.
moves.say: “I feel happy because the tree says ‘Leaf me alone!’”
moves.think: A tree talking is funny. It makes me smile, so my face is 😄. My reason is the joke: ‘Leaf me alone!’

moves.do: Read the plants fact. The whole class finishes your sentence.
moves.how: Then ask: where do you see plants at home? Take three answers in full sentences.
moves.say: “I feel surprised because …” → class: “… plants give us air!”

moves.do: Window side says a reason; other points to its bubble and feeling.
moves.how: Ayesha and Bilal show it first. A checks p.123. Two pairs share aloud.

turn.a: Because snow leopards can jump really far.
turn.b: This bubble. (points) You feel surprised because they jump far.
turn.help: Point to the bubble; say “You feel …”.

moves.do: Everyone writes alone: draw each face, write one because word.
moves.how: 1. snow leopards · 2. tree joke. Done? 3. Write the whole sentence for the waves joke.
moves.say: “Draw how you feel. Write one word: why?”

sections.mistake: Draws a face, no reason. Ask: “What did Sir Riaz say?” The child points to the word in the bubble and copies it.
sections.stuck: Point to one face on the board; the child names it, then copies because + one word.

moves.do: Say a new fact: “Bees visit flowers to make honey.”
moves.how: Each child shows the face alone; five children each say why aloud: “I feel ___ because ___.”

sections.correct: a face + a reason from the fact (“… because bees make honey”).
sections.success: I can say how I feel and give one reason.
sections.ask: Which part of the fact made you feel that way?
sections.listen: The detail: bees visit flowers and make honey. Any reason from the fact.

moves.do: Tell a family member one joke or fact from p.123
